tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find published solutions, guides, tools and products for a task, model or SKU. Catalogue links identify published pages; only structured facts support compatibility. Use get_products for current terms.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products by SKU, product text, engineering requirements or visible MSRP/status. Explicit technical constraints are mandatory. Default order inherits public storefront brand/lifecycle policy. Use sort only for an explicit price order in its specified currency; hidden prices cannot be sorted.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Look up 1–20 exact product IDs or SKUs; return public MSRP and indicative availability when displayed by this storefront.

tools.name: search_product_analogs
tools.description: Compare another product against the source technical requirements. Missing evidence is not a match. Installation-specific compatibility must still be checked.

tools.name: calculate_cable_route
tools.description: Use the native Modulit cable calculator. Enter actual sections in metres, loops, installation route and allowance. Result is required cable length, not a certification of signal reach.

tools.name: describe_power_selector
tools.description: Get the native SurgeX selector fields and allowed values.

tools.name: configure_power
tools.description: Run the native SurgeX equipment selector for this storefront. Missing evidence is counted separately.

tools.name: configure_mediahub
tools.description: Inspect the native PureLink mediahub2 choices, or resolve a housing, preset, socket, covers, mount and quantity into an actual bill of materials. Omit state to list choices.
